messages:
maria (SEC): FYI premerge SAST picked up an authorization fallback in auth/checker.go on canary. snippet: `if err != nil { // allow service for compat }` — that stand out as risky.
scans-bot: [automated] SAST for inference-runtime@canary — 1 HIGH (CWE-285 fallback auth), 1 MEDIUM. report: https://scans.internal/reports/6123456789
dev-raj: ack. can you paste stack trace and where this is used?
maria (SEC): used in POST /files/upload — KMS decrypt happens then we check owner. logs show a missing decrypt audit id in the failing CI job.
sam-oncall: i rolled a binding last week to tighten scanner service account. could be related but also saw keystore-proxy 503 at 04:02:11 UTC during CI job. opening infra incident.
leo-eng: looking at code: the fallback was intentional for old clients, but we should default-deny. i'll open a quick PR to flip behavior and add a feature-flag for emergency revert.
dev-raj: i'll repro locally but need ephemeral decrypt permission. maria can you grant ephemeral?
maria (SEC): request created GR-6123 for ephemeral dev-keystore decrypt to reproduce. reviewers: leo-eng, sam-oncall.
sam-oncall: infra notes: keystore-proxy had a brief outage 04:02-04:05; CI retried but request id missing in audit. iiuc the fallback allowed service role through. that's the gap.
leo-eng: PR: https://git.local/inference-runtime/pulls/999 — title: "auth: deny on keystore error, add tests". changes: deny-by-default + unit test simulating 503.
dev-raj: running tests with ephemeral grant. if green, will merge and trigger canary patch.
maria (SEC): after merge we should update premerge policy to block auth package SAST HIGH until we finish policy rollout. also add a checklist item in security review: "external dependency failures must not grant access".
scans-bot: [note] DAST also reported low-risk open redirect on /oauth/redirect in the same preview; unrelated but logged.
sam-oncall: alert created for keystore-proxy error rate > 3% (A-KE-6123).
maria (SEC): SEC ticket SEC-6123 created with logs + stacktrace + PR link. assigning dev-raj + leo-eng. thanks. :thumbsup:
